comment: Configuration for regress.py. Paths are relative to the repo root.

deviations.comment: Figures whose example intentionally differs from the book by a marked line. Currently none — the ERRATA.md issues were fixed in the manuscript on 2026-07-08. Book-sync only checks listed figures for a deviation marker.

compare_modes.comment: Binaries with nondeterministic output (HashMap iteration). 'unordered_lines' ignores line order (map iterated one entry per line). 'normalized_maps' sorts the entries inside {...} on each line (map printed inline via {:?}). Everything else compares exactly.

quarantine.comment: Chapter crates not yet converted to the build/connect refactor (branch put_uvm_back_in_rustdv). Excluded from the workspace build; their sim tests are skipped and reported as quarantined rather than passing. This keeps the suite a usable instrument while the refactor lands — red means we broke something, not that work is in progress. REMOVE a chapter from both lists the moment its example compiles and runs.

cargo_test_packages.comment: Packages whose unit tests run as part of the examples suite. Add future crates (e.g. rustdv) here or as custom tests.
